name: Kunohe (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kunohe village emblem in white: a ring open at the fly enclosing the characters 九戸.
history: Municipal flag of Kunohe, a village in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 June 1964.

features.role: Kunohe village emblem — a ring open at the fly enclosing the characters 九戸
